sentences.en: At first, Byrd and his men were able to take a great many photographs of the mountains that lay below.
sentences.zh: 起初，伯德和他的伙伴们还能拍下许多横亘于下的山脉的照片。

sentences.en: But they soon ran into serious trouble.

article.en: In 1929, three years after his flight over the North Pole, the American explorer, R. E. Byrd, successfully flew over the South Pole for the first time.
article.zh: 1929年，在他飞越北极三年之后，美国探险家R·E·伯德首次成功飞越了南极。

article.en: At first, Byrd and his men were able to take a great many photographs of the mountains that lay below.
article.zh: 起初，伯德和他的伙伴们还能拍下许多横亘于下的山脉的照片。

article.en: But they soon ran into serious trouble.
article.zh: 但很快他们就陷入了困境。

article.en: At one point, it seemed certain that their plane would crash.
article.zh: 有一刻，飞机似乎肯定要坠毁了。

article.en: It could only get over the mountains if it rose to 10,000 feet.
article.zh: 只有上升到一万英尺的高度，飞机才能飞过群山。

article.en: Byrd at once ordered his men to throw out two heavy food sacks.
article.zh: 伯德立刻命令伙伴们把两个沉重的食物袋扔下去。

article.en: The plane was then able to rise and it cleared the mountains by 400 feet.
article.zh: 于是飞机可以上升了，它在离山头400英尺的高度飞越了过去。

article.en: Byrd now knew that he would be able to reach the South Pole which was 300 miles away.
article.zh: 伯德现在知道，他能够到达300英里以外的南极了。

article.en: The aircraft was able to fly over the endless white plains without difficulty.
article.zh: 飞机可以毫无困难地飞过这片茫茫无际的白色原野。
